zh-Hans: 能赢的比赛绝不能丢，这是我们职业车手的铁则！
en: Never throw away a race you can win. That's an iron rule for us professionals!

zh-Hans: 动力看来相当足，不过你能踩到底到什么时候呢？
en: You've got plenty of power. But how long can you keep your foot down?

zh-Hans: 可不能陪你那辆车玩太久。
en: I can't spend too long playing with that car.

zh-Hans: 我也有职业车手的面子要顾。
en: I've got my reputation as a pro to think of.

zh-Hans: 业余车手能跑成这样，倒让我意外。
en: Not bad for an amateur. I'm surprised.

zh-Hans: 看来我也该认真了。
en: Time for me to get serious.

zh-Hans: 竟然能跟我势均力敌，超出预料啊。
en: Matching me blow for blow... You're better than I expected.

zh-Hans: 没法再攻进去？不可能。
en: I can't push any harder? That can't be right.

zh-Hans: 失算了，竟然能做到这种地步。
en: I miscalculated. I didn't think you could go this far.

zh-Hans: 那股像是把命押在山路弯道上的劲头，简直像看见当年的自己。
en: That intensity, as if his life depends on every corner... It's like looking at my younger self.

zh-Hans: 倒也算不上差。
en: Well, he's not bad.

zh-Hans: 什么？糟了！
en: What? I blew it!

zh-Hans: 真没办法，倒霉的时候也就是这样。
en: Well, that's how it goes when luck isn't on your side.

zh-Hans: 什么？
en: What?

zh-Hans: 不可能……
en: Impossible...

zh-Hans: 可恶！
en: Ugh!

zh-Hans: 啊。
en: Ah.

zh-Hans: 糟了！
en: I blew it!

zh-Hans: 搞不懂，这种较量到底有什么意义？
en: I don't get it. What's the point of a battle like this?

zh-Hans: 事到如今再跑山，水平太低，对我只是浪费时间。
en: Mountain battles at this point? The level's too low. It's a waste of my time.

zh-Hans: 这种地方，怎么可能有我想找的答案？
en: How could the answer I'm looking for be in a place like this?

zh-Hans: 没被甩开，一直咬着啊。还真是件稀罕事。
en: He's keeping up without falling back. That's quite something.

zh-Hans: 你确实厉害，不过赢的会是我。
en: You're impressive. But I'm still going to win.

zh-Hans: 还在，他还跟着！
en: He's there! He's still with me!

zh-Hans: 只要我跑在前面，差距就会很明显。
en: With me in front, the difference will be clear.

zh-Hans: 你那辆车的实力，我已经摸得一清二楚。
en: I know exactly what your car is capable of.

zh-Hans: 还真跟得紧，怪别扭的，说不出是什么感觉。
en: He's really staying with me. It feels oddly unsettling.

zh-Hans: 离终点不远了，我会集中精神把工作做完。
en: Not far to the finish. I'll stay focused and finish the job.

zh-Hans: 说白了，公路上的输赢，取决于车的水平。
en: Frankly, on public roads, the car decides who wins.

zh-Hans: 这里没有答案，开始之前就该知道了。
en: I knew before we started that there'd be no answer here.

zh-Hans: 跑山和正规赛车，差距实在太大。
en: The gap between mountain runs and proper racing is enormous.

zh-Hans: 看清楚了，房车赛里，还有这种超车方法！
en: Watch closely. This is one way we pass in touring-car racing!

zh-Hans: 一口气甩开，就此结束。业余车手里，你算不错的了。
en: I'll pull away and end this. For an amateur, you weren't bad.

zh-Hans: 别怪我，这种程度的事，在那边可是家常便饭。
en: No hard feelings. This sort of thing happens all the time in my world.

zh-Hans: 哼。
en: Hmph.

zh-Hans: 好。
en: Good.

zh-Hans: 拿下了。
en: Got you.

zh-Hans: 收下了。
en: It's mine.

zh-Hans: 结束了。
en: It's over.

zh-Hans: 真服了，居然能跑成那样。说真的，我吃了一惊。
en: I have to hand it to you. To go that far... I'm honestly amazed.

zh-Hans: 一切都是经验。当上赛车手后，我学到了很多。
en: It's all experience. I've learned a lot since becoming a racer.

zh-Hans: 让你认清职业和业余之间，究竟差了多少。
en: I'll show you just how big the gap between a pro and an amateur is.

zh-Hans: 既然决定跑了，就算对手是业余车手，我也不会放水。
en: Now that I've agreed to race, I won't hold back, even against an amateur.
